name: ws-ml
description: Intervention Explorer - a clean-room, fully client-side demo of exploratory analysis over invented intervention-operation records, with filtering, aggregation, inline-SVG comparison charts, detail inspection and a client-generated CSV export. No trained or predictive model is represented.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
